cards.summaryOriginal: Evaluating agents by outcomes alone can obscure the capabilities that produce them. cards.summaryOriginal: Generating complete, coherent, and usable 3D indoor scenes from natural language requires strong design intelligence: the ability to design high-quality scenes and critique their quality.
